shortBio.en: Nirvana drummer (1990–94) who became Foo Fighters frontman and later drummed in Them Crooked Vultures.
shortBio.zh: Nirvana 鼓手（1990–94），后任 Foo Fighters 主唱，并在 Them Crooked Vultures 司鼓。

whyHub.en: Connects Nirvana → Foo Fighters → Them Crooked Vultures: role change (drums to frontman) as career structure.
whyHub.zh: 连接 Nirvana → Foo Fighters → Them Crooked Vultures：角色转换（鼓手到主唱）即职业结构。

body.en:
Born 1969. Locks Nirvana’s peak trio with Cobain/Novoselic; after 1994 builds Foo Fighters from solo demos into a touring alternative/hard-rock band; 2009–10 joins Homme and John Paul Jones in Them Crooked Vultures.

Hub value is personnel flow across logos. Musical constants: hard kick as drummer, stacked choruses as singer.
body.zh:
1969 年生。与 Cobain/Novoselic 锁定 Nirvana 巅峰三人组；1994 年后从独唱 demo 建成 Foo Fighters 巡演 alternative/hard-rock 乐队；2009–10 与 Homme、John Paul Jones 组成 Them Crooked Vultures。

枢纽价值是跨 logo 的人事流动。音乐常量：司鼓时的硬底鼓，主唱时的堆叠副歌。

note.zh: 超级组合鼓/人声，短周期。
